answer: Because the pigment collateral is checked against the glacier claim at intake, the raven audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. Posted collateral must equal 8 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases as a result has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. That is 38 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
